instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: A multinational pharmaceutical company specializing in large-molecule drug development and manufacturing. They operate heavily regulated supply chains across multiple continents, focusing on complex R&D and compliance.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company has implemented several incremental improvements focused on optimizing clinical trial documentation workflows and automating lab scheduling. Recently, they initiated a pilot project exploring AI for early drug candidate toxicity prediction.
answers.strategicGoals: To significantly reduce operational costs by 15% through process re-engineering while maintaining stringent regulatory compliance standards. The goal is also to accelerate time-to-market for new therapies.
answers.teamSize: A cross-functional team of 15 highly specialized scientists and process engineers works closely on innovation projects.
answers.additionalContext: The company faces intense competition in the generic drug space and constantly adapting to rapidly changing global regulatory requirements.

opportunities.title: End-to-End Autonomous Compliance System (E2ECS)
opportunities.rationale: Given the high regulatory environment and efficiency priority, implementing a radical AI-driven system could automate regulatory submission preparation, real-time compliance monitoring, and risk assessment across all stages of drug development. This would fundamentally transform current slow manual processes into an automated feedback loop.

first_actions: Conduct a feasibility study on integrating GenAI with existing regulatory documentation repositories.
resources_needed: Seed funding for pilot program infrastructure
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in compliance review cycle time by 60% within 18 months.
milestones: Q2: Successful deployment of predictive modeling tool on one minor regulatory filing.
Q4: Full integration into the core R&D pipeline.

opportunities.title: Lean Manufacturing 4.0 Implementation
opportunities.rationale: Focusing on incremental efficiency, this involves implementing IoT sensors and predictive maintenance across the manufacturing floor to reduce equipment downtime and optimize resource allocation.

first_actions: Install sensor network on three critical production lines.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in unplanned equipment downtime by 20% annually.
milestones: Q3: Sensor network deployment and baseline data collection.
Q1 next year: Achieve target uptime metrics.

next_steps.action: Form a dedicated task force to evaluate the technical viability and regulatory hurdles of the Autonomous Compliance System.
Finalize the budget request for the Lean Manufacturing 4.0 pilot project.
Launch internal workshops to identify cultural barriers preventing cross-departmental process adoption.

key_weaknesses: Siloed data between R&D and Manufacturing teams leading to redundant testing efforts.
Legacy IT infrastructure that hinders rapid deployment of new process automation technologies.
High turnover rate among specialized regulatory compliance talent due to intense industry pressure.
